arms.name: Craft v3, subject only
arms.idea: Craft v2 without the staged base: the code goes to the subject

arms.name: Craft v3, flat colour only
arms.idea: craft3 with every texture ask cut: texture-free copies of contract, taste, ambition2 and craft3 that ask for one flat colour per part and detail carried by geometry, and no paint.ts or texture.ts source

arms.name: Two-stage build with requests
arms.idea: Stage 1: one call on the flat arm's system prompt plus two-stage1.md writes the whole model in flat colours, ending with a request list (details to add and textures to paint, each tied to a part and a place) and a STAGE2 hook, and renders on its own (first pixel). Stage 2, all at once on craft3's system prompt: the add requests in up to 6 calls that each return one function appended to the module, and the texture requests in one SEARCH/REPLACE edit call on stage 1's code; the runner merges them into one module.
